notes: COUNTS VERIFIED. en.json = 590 flattened keys; cn.json = 511; zh-tw.json = 511. Missing from cn = 93. Present-but-byte-identical-to-en = 140. In cn but not in en = 14. Zero of the 140 identical values contain any CJK.

Broader untranslated total: 162 of 511 cn values contain NO CJK at all (349 do). The extra 22 beyond the 140 are: the 14 orphans, 6 TYPES.* keys reworded in English (TYPES.Actor.character='Player Character' vs en 'Character', .colony='Colony Sheet', .planet='Colony Planet', .spacecraft='Space Ship', .vehicles='Vehicle', TYPES.Item.specialty='Speciality'), 1 whitespace-only diff (ALIENRPG.ShipPanic9), and 1 JSON null.

ALIENRPG.EVCriticalInjuries is JSON null in BOTH cn.json and zh-tw.json (en = 'EV - Critical Injuries'). Foundry's Localization#localize returns the key string for a non-string value, so actor.mjs:1812 calls game.tables.getName('ALIENRPG.EVCriticalInjuries') then falls back to the English name. Harmless but it is a malformed lang file.

The 14 orphan keys are the deprecated pre-v11 document-type namespace and are DEAD: ACTOR.TypeCharacter/Colony/Creature/Planet/Spacecraft/Synthetic/Territory/Vehicles (8) and ITEM.TypeAgenda/Armor/Colony-initiative/Critical-injury/Item/Weapon (6). Foundry v12+ reads TYPES.Actor.* / TYPES.Item.* instead, which cn.json also has but left in English.

The 93 missing keys are not random: they are one contiguous generation of features added to en.json after the last non-German translation sync. Clusters: (a) the whole Alien Evolved ruleset -- ALIENRPG.Evolved, EvolvedHint, Resolve, ResolveMod, RollStress, StressResponses/StressResponseRoll, PanicResponses/PanicResponseRoll, Response, Result, NoResolveTable, and 20 stress/panic condition names (jumpy, tunnelvision, aggravated, shakes, frantic, deflated, fatigued, keepingguard, spooked, noisy, twitchy, loseitem, paranoid, hesitant, freeze, seekcover, scream, flee, frenzy, catatonic); (b) the ranged-attack dialog -- targetRange, targetCover, targetSize, nocover/partialcover/fullcover, normal/large/small, carefullAim, aimForWeakSpot, firingFullAuto, conserveAmmo, ammoConcerved, FullAuto; (c) ALIENRPG.dialog.* (ok, cancel, roll, Modifier, howManyDice, Rollontable, Tooltip-ManualRoll, Tooltip-Rollontable); (d) ALIENRPG.SheetLabels.* (9); (e) ALIENRPG.Item.Tabs.* (5) and ALIENRPG.Item.General.FIELDS.* (6); (f) 12 dead boilerplate ALIENRPG.Ability.Str/Dex/Con/Int/Wis/Cha.abbr/long.

Of the 93 missing keys, 68 are actually referenced by module code or templates, i.e. 68 strings visibly fall back to English at runtime. The other 25 are dead (Ability.* boilerplate, unused dialog keys).

Cross-check of what code REFERENCES vs what cn.json DEFINES: 494 distinct ALIENRPG/TYPES/ACTOR/ITEM keys are referenced statically. 68 are missing from cn; another 98 exist in cn but are still English. So 166 of 494 live keys (34%) render English today.

34 keys are referenced but do NOT exist in en.json either (they render as the raw dotted key in every language). 13 of those are false alarms (LOCALIZATION_PREFIXES stubs ALIENRPG.Actor.base/Character/Colony/Creature/Spacecraft/Synthetic/Territory/Vehicle, ALIENRPG.Item, ALIENRPG.Item.base, ALIENRPG.Item.Feature, ALIENRPG.Weapon, ALIENRPG.ActiveEffect.base/abilityModifier; plus concat prefixes ALIENRPG.Skill and ALIENRPG.AbilityAbb used by the alienConcat helper, and the hook name ALIENRPG.prepareActiveEffectData). The genuinely broken ones that WILL show as raw keys: ALIENRPG.ActiveEffect.Temporary / .Passive / .Inactive (effects-tab section headers on character/creature/synthetic sheets), ALIENRPG.ActiveEffect.Expired, ALIENRPG.Effect.Temporary (helpers/effects.mjs:11), ALIENRPG.ActorSheet.Edit and ALIENRPG.ActorSheet.Delete (crt/vehicles-sheet.html:103,105 tooltips), ALIENRPG.General.NeedToImportActor (error toast in 3 sheets), ALIENRPG.SHEET.Labels.ActiveEffect (alienrpg.mjs:231), ALIENRPG.Apparance, ALIENRPG.Special, ALIENRPG.cost, ALIENRPG.ResolveS, ALIENRPG.Close (all config.mjs label pointers), ALIENRPG.Init.SubModule, ALIENRPG.creature.Health. Adding these to cn.json alone does nothing -- Foundry only merges keys that exist for the ACTIVE language, so a cn.json entry for a key en.json lacks WILL still work (translations are merged per-language, en is only a fallback), so these ARE fixable from cn.json.

LOCALIZATION_PREFIXES are declared on 26 DataModels (ALIENRPG.Actor.*, ALIENRPG.Item, ALIENRPG.Weapon, ALIENRPG.ActiveEffect.*) but almost no matching .FIELDS.*.label keys exist -- only ALIENRPG.Item.General.FIELDS.{dieSize,numDice,quantity,rollFormula,rollMod,weight}.label, and even those are under the wrong path for the declared prefix. DataModel-driven field labels/hints are therefore effectively unwired system-wide.

HARD COUPLING WARNING: module/documents/actor.mjs:1888-1940 PARSES the critical-injury RollTable result text and string-compares it against game.i18n.localize('ALIENRPG.Yes')+' ', +', -1 ', +', -2 ', ALIENRPG.None+' ', ALIENRPG.OneRound+' ', ALIENRPG.OneTurn+' ', ALIENRPG.OneShift+' ', ALIENRPG.OneDay+' ', ALIENRPG.Permanent, and the bare literal 'Shift'. cn.json ALREADY breaks this: None='莫', OneRound='一回合', OneTurn='一斡', OneShift='一轮班' are translated while the shipped English crit tables still say 'None'/'One Round'/'One Shift', so healTime always falls through to 0 and 'Fatal' detection depends on Yes/Permanent/Shift happening to still be English. Any cn translation MUST keep these 8 keys byte-identical to whatever the (Babele-)translated crit tables emit, or translate both in lockstep.

Language-code note: system.json declares the Chinese entry as lang 'cn' (name '中文'), not zh-Hans/zh-CN. This matches this user's installed stack (foundry_chn, pf2_cn, crucible-cn all use 'cn'), so an override module must also declare 'cn'. EFFECT.* keys used in active-effect/config-duration.hbs resolve from foundry_chn; DRAW_STEEL.* resolve from nothing.

summary: ALIENRPG v4.1.13 i18n audit (Foundry Data\systems\alienrpg). Scope scanned: lang/*.json (9 files), 80 .hbs + 21 .html templates (79 hbs under templates/ plus module/helpers/alienprgSettings.hbs, which is the one actually rendered), 62 .mjs under module/ (20,024 lines), css/alienrpg.css, system.json. LANG GAP (verified, matches the numbers given). en.json 590 flattened keys; cn.json 511; zh-tw.json 511. 93 keys missing from cn, 140 present-but-byte-identical to English, 14 orphans in cn not in en. Broader: 162 of 511 cn values contain no CJK at all (349 do); 1 value is JSON null (ALIENRPG.EVCriticalInjuries, null in both cn and zh-tw). Placeholder loss: 0 (only 2 en keys have placeholders at all). HTML tag loss: 0. The 14 orphans are the dead pre-v11 ACTOR.Type*/ITEM.Type* namespace; the live TYPES.Actor.*/TYPES.Item.* equivalents exist in cn but are English. Against actual usage: 494 distinct keys are referenced by code+templates; 68 of them are missing from cn and 98 more are still English, so 166/494 (34%) of live strings render English today. A further 13 keys are referenced but exist in NO lang file and render as raw dotted keys for everyone (ALIENRPG.ActiveEffect.Temporary/.Passive/.Inactive/.Expired, ALIENRPG.Effect.Temporary, ALIENRPG.ActorSheet.Edit/.Delete, ALIENRPG.General.NeedToImportActor, ALIENRPG.SHEET.Labels.ActiveEffect, ALIENRPG.Apparance, ALIENRPG.Special, ALIENRPG.cost, ALIENRPG.ResolveS, ALIENRPG.Close, ALIENRPG.Init.SubModule, ALIENRPG.creature.Health) - all of these ARE reachable from cn.json since Foundry merges per-language, en is only a fallback. ZH-TW vs CN - VERDICT: they are SIBLINGS from one Simplified-Chinese ancestor, not a copy of one another. Evidence: identical 511-key set in identical key ORDER; 342/511 values byte-identical; of the 169 that differ, 157 differ ONLY by S<->T character substitution; zh-tw.json still contains 101 values that are pure Simplified and were never converted (e.g. ALIENRPG.forceImportHint '强制重新导入...覆盖现有数据', ALIENRPG.Overwatch '守望先锋', all 12 TAH.* tooltips, all settings hints), while cn.json contains ZERO Traditional-only values and neither file has a mixed-script value. zh-tw is therefore an incomplete automated S->T pass over a Simplified base (~29% of its Chinese strings never converted). cn is NOT a T->S conversion of zh-tw either: the 12 non-script differences prove independent divergence (cn cinematic='电影' vs tw 'CINEMA'; cn CrewGunner='炮手' vs tw ' 炮手'; cn ShipPanic7/ShipConButtons match en.json byte-for-byte while tw has extra spaces; ShipPanic7/ShipPanic9 leading-space counts are swapped between the two files). Practical takeaway: cn.json is the cleaner and more canonical of the two - build from cn, and treat zh-tw as derivative. Wider context: cn/es/fr/it/pt-br/zh-tw ALL share the exact same 511-key set in the same order (same 93 missing, same 14 orphans) - one bulk snapshot of an older en.json. Only de.json is current (590/590); pl.json has 508. CN QUALITY: heavily machine-translated with 107 keys tripping automated defect heuristics. Marquee failures: GMONLY='仅限通用汽车' (GM -> General Motors), Overwatch='守望先锋' (the Blizzard game), SelectFirer='选择消防员' (firer -> firefighter), Utility='公用事业', Wildcatter='野猫', Homebrew='家酿', None='莫', OneTurn='一斡', SheetColorSettings='图纸颜色设置' (its own settings dialog title), CombatantReroll='重新启动计划'. 'Roll' is rendered as 滚动 (scroll) in 9 keys; 'Actor' as 演员 in 3; 'Token' as both 令牌 and 指示物; 'Push' as 孤注一掷 / 按钮 / 推送; 'Critical Injury' as 重伤 / 严重伤害 / 暴击 / 重击; 'Damage' as 伤害 / 损害 / 损坏; 'Stress Level' as 压力等级 / 压力水平; 'Panic' as 恐慌 / 混乱. hideInitChatHint hallucinates a clause ('以备不时之需') not in the source. Panic8 collapses 'AGILITY (Mobility)' to 敏捷（敏捷）. facehugger is left untranslated in one key and rendered 抱脸者 (wrong) in another. 40 concrete cases are in stale_or_wrong; treat cn.json as a re-translation target, not a base to patch. HARDCODED TOTALS. Templates: 80 unreachable sites across 101 files - 38 text spans (templates/actor/planet-general.hbs, the whole Colony Planet sheet, which contains exactly ONE {{localize}} call), 23 literal title= attributes ('Minus'/'Plus' steppers x18, 'Stunts' x2, 'Create item' x2, 'Edit Item'), 10
